Hardin Design & Development is hiring an entry-level web developer to participate in all aspects of the development process. The role includes web application design and development, daily client interaction, and application planning and implementation.

Required
A solid base-level understanding of basic algorithms and data structures, as well as how to implement/use them is required
A good candidate should also have in-depth proficiency in one or more programing languages
Other combinations of training and/or experience which can be demonstrated to result in possession of the knowledge, skills and abilities that are needed to perform the tasks of this position will also be considered
Preferred
A college degree in computer science or related field is preferred, but not required
Preference will be given to candidates with proficiency in relevant languages and technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, etc
The ability to run and maintain at least one common web application stack (such as LAMP) as well as a background working with relational databases (SQL) is also desired, but not strictly required
knowledge of both is a major plus
Experience using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Codex
Experience maintaining infrastructure hosted by Amazon Web Services or a similar cloud provider
Experience working with any common front-end frameworks (ReactJS, VueJS, Angular, etc.) or back-end frameworks (Laravel, Symfony, Express in Node.js, Django in Python, etc.)
Experience with CI/CD solutions
Experience with Docker
Design, browser compatibility, a demonstration of strong technical proficiency, breadth of knowledge, the ability to learn quickly, and a strong desire to grow as a developer
Benefits
An in-network POS healthcare plan with minimum co-pays through Quartz
A retirement package
An easy-going work atmosphere
A casual dress code
A game room
A large open office right in the heart of Madison’s East Washington corridor
Opportunity for career advancement within the company
The company is open to hybrid models and remote work with trusted long term employees, but new hires must start out working from our Madison office.
